name: Kryon web player: bundle Wasm tier against the instruction engine
ziran_revision: efe3fabf (player built from the working tree with the suspendable tier)
methodology: Kryon build/zx-canvas player (Asyncify) in a private headless Chromium (snap) driven over the DevTools protocol. After the page loads, the on-screen joystick is held so the app steps on every repeat; main-thread TaskDuration (Performance.getMetrics) is read over a 10 s window. Engine runs set globalThis.ZIRAN_WASM_TIER = "0" before the page loads. Three alternating runs per mode through build-queue; medians of raw samples, none excluded by the symmetric 1.5×IQR rule. The first tier run of the series included cold page and module compilation.
